image_description: A close-up, high-angle shot of a European fire salamander (Salamandra salamandra) resting on a substrate of small, light-colored gravel and pebbles. The salamander features a glossy black body with distinct, irregular bright yellow patches and spots covering its head, back, and limbs. Its skin appears moist and reflective. The head is broad with visible eyes, and the forelimbs are clearly visible with blunt digits. The tail extends towards the upper right, partially out of frame.
